=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:176-177 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The structured failure log emits `pr=${PR_NUMBER:-?}`, which can produce a literal `?` token when `PR_NUMBER` is unset.
  WHY: This is harmless at runtime but makes machine parsing of the log line brittle; both reviewers identified the same log-shape issue.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:176-196 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The commit-message skip logic is brittle because it depends on the current first-line subject shape and, in the tab-split path, assumes the metadata format stays exactly as produced today.
  WHY: If the commit message format changes or the subject contains leading whitespace/tab characters, the skip may fail to activate and cause redundant verification; reviewer severity differed only by emphasis, so the highest is kept.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:191-195 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The author-email guard is hard-coded to `codex@users.noreply.github.com`, so the skip will not trigger if the bot identity changes.
  WHY: This is a brittle dependency on one exact noreply address; reviewers noted it is intentional as a security boundary, but it is still a single-point identity match.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3838-3842 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The claimed unset-variable crash in the post-commit retrigger guard is not present because the code already defaults `DID_COMMIT` and `CONFLICT_RESOLVED`.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly verified the current `${VAR:-default}` handling, so this is a stale cross-pollination concern rather than a live bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:176-177 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The commit message parsing uses `${head_meta%%$'\t'*}` and `${head_meta#*$'\t'}`, which assumes the GitHub API metadata is cleanly tab-separated.
  WHY: If the commit subject contains a tab character, the split can misparse the subject and author email, making the skip fail.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:181 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fallback `?` in `${PR_NUMBER:-?}` can make the structured log ambiguous.
  WHY: When `PR_NUMBER` is unset, the log line contains a literal `?`, which can confuse log parsers.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:183-184 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The no-tab guard does not handle an empty subject case.
  WHY: If the API returned only an email and no subject, the subject check could fail silently.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:185,191 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gate job’s commit probe and author check are brittle, and the post-commit retrigger step can be unsafe if variables are missing.
  WHY: The parsing assumes a single tab separator, the author guard assumes one exact no-reply address, and `DID_COMMIT`/`CONFLICT_RESOLVED` were called out as needing defaults under `set -u`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:182-199 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The commit-message prefix detection only inspects the first line and can miss the prefix if leading whitespace is introduced before `[ai-autofix]`.
  WHY: The current first-line match is correct for today’s format, but future template changes could make the skip silently fail to activate.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:191 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The hard-coded author email creates a brittle dependency on a specific noreply address format.
  WHY: The code works today, but if GitHub changes the codex noreply address, the skip will stop working.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:182-188 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The tab-based split assumes exactly one tab separator and can misparse if the subject itself contains a tab.
  WHY: The string manipulation would extract the wrong fields in that edge case, causing a false negative or incorrect log output.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3841-3842 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The reported missing-defaults issue for `DID_COMMIT` and `CONFLICT_RESOLVED` is already handled in the code.
  WHY: The current retrigger guard uses `${DID_COMMIT:-false}` and `${CONFLICT_RESOLVED:-false}`, so the stale finding does not describe a live bug.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:176 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gate log line uses `pr=${PR_NUMBER:-?}`, which emits a non-key-value token when the PR number is unavailable.
  WHY: This does not break execution, but it makes the structured log output harder to parse reliably.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:172-196 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The commit-message prefix check only examines the first line, so future format changes could bypass the skip.
  WHY: The current behavior is safe but cost-inefficient if the message shape changes and the prefix is no longer on the first line.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:195 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The author email guard is hard-coded to `codex@users.noreply.github.com`.
  WHY: If the bot uses a different noreply address, the skip will never trigger and the cost-saving path is lost.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
